entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:1
segments: When the LORD your God has cut off the nations whose land the LORD your God gives you, and when you take their place and live in their cities and in their houses,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:2
segments: you shall separate three cities for you in the middle of your land, which the LORD your God gives you to possess it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:3
segments: You shall prepare you a way, and divide the borders of your land which the LORD your God gives you to inherit, into three parts, so that every slayer may flee there.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:4
segments: And this [is] the case of the slayer who shall flee there that he may live: whoever in error kills his neighbor whom he did not hate him before,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:5
segments: even he who goes into the wood with his neighbor to cut wood, and his hand brings a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the wood and lights on his neighbor so that he dies; he shall flee to one of those cities and live,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:6
segments: so that the avenger of the blood may not pursue the slayer while his heart is hot, and overtake him because the way is long, and kill him, and he had no sentence worthy of death, for he did not hate him in time past.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:7
segments: Therefore I command you saying, You shall separate three cities for you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:8
segments: And if the LORD your God makes your border larger, as He has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which He promised to give to your fathers;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:9
segments: if you will keep all these commandments which I command you today, to do them, to love the LORD your God, and to walk always in His ways, then you shall add to yourself three more cities to these three,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:10
segments: so that innocent blood may not be shed in your land which the LORD your God gives you [for] an inheritance and blood may not be on you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:11
segments: But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him and rises up against him and strikes his life from him, so that he dies, and flees to one of these cities,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:12
segments: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him away from there and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood so that he may die.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:13
segments: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall put away innocent blood from Israel, so that it may go well with you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:14
segments: You may not remove your neighbor's landmark, which those in the past have set in your inheritance, which you shall inherit in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:15
segments: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be made sure.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:16
segments: If a false witness rises up against any man to testify a falling away against him,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:17
segments: then both the men who are disagreeing shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges which shall be in those days.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:18
segments: And the judges shall make careful inquiry. And behold, [if] the witness [is] a false witness [and] has testified falsely against his brother,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:19
segments: then you shall do to him as he had thought to have done to his brother. So you shall put the evil away from among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:20
segments: And those who remain shall hear and fear, and shall commit from then on no such evil among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:21
segments: And your eye shall not pity. Life [shall go] for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
